description: Handles PHI on behalf of CE
Person legally authorized to make health care decisions for or act on behalf of an individual (or a deceased individual's estate); treated as the individual under the Rule (45 CFR 164.502(g))
Minor individual; a parent is generally the personal representative except where State/other law provides otherwise
Employer, union, or employee organization that sponsors a group health plan and may receive limited PHI subject to plan-document restrictions
